title.value: AN ACT to amend the environmental conservation law, in relation to prohibiting the sale and distribution of anti-fogging sprays or wipes containing perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances
title.provenance: AN  ACT  to  amend  the  environmental  conservation law, in relation to prohibiting the sale and distribution of anti-fogging sprays or  wipes containing perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances

status.provenance: Introduced  by  M.  of  A.  GALLAGHER,  STERN, GONZALEZ-ROJAS, JACOBSON, LEVENBERG, SIMON, SIMONE, ROSENTHAL,  COLTON,  REYES,  SHIMSKY,  RAGA, CLARK,  SEAWRIGHT, FORREST, OTIS, BURDICK, MAMDANI, MEEKS -- read once and referred to the Committee on Environmental Conservation

pfas_definition.provenance: "Perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances" or "PFAS" means a class of fluorinated organic chemicals containing at least one fully fluorinated carbon atom.

type.provenance: 2. After December thirty-first, two thousand twenty-six, no person ... shall sell or offer for sale ... anti-fogging sprays or wipes containing perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances

date.provenance: § 3. This act shall take effect  immediately.

value: good faith reliance on the written assurance of the manufacturer (certificate of compliance)
exceptions.provenance: 3.  No person that sells or offers for sale any anti-fogging sprays or  wipes shall be held in violation of this section if they can  show  that  they  relied  in good faith on the written assurance of the manufacturer  of such product that such product met the requirements of this  section.
